summary: Public projects created on 4 May 2026: 4 repos and 1 dataset.
intro: Work on Claude Code tooling includes a snapshot of a live session's context output and an agent plugin that labels hardware components in photos, backed by a PCB annotation demo. A separate thread covers noisy audio: a small hand-curated set of real-world voice notes and an undocumented audio sample collection.

projects.name: Claude Context Analysis 0526
projects.description: Point-in-time snapshot of /context output from a live Claude Code session, captured 2026-05-04.

projects.name: Claude Hardware ID Annotation Plugin
projects.description: Identify and annotate hardware components from photos — circuit boards, motherboards, ICs — with overlays, datasheet cross-checks, and structured BOMs.

projects.name: PCB Labeller Demo
projects.description: Proof of concept: using AI to annotate PCB (and other hardware) images and help the user plan a project, coupled with light research assistance.

projects.name: Noisy Voice Notes
projects.description: A small, hand-curated set of real-world voice notes recorded over roughly a year by a single speaker (me — Daniel Rosehill), captured in everyday environments rather than a studio.
